generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor of at least one contract and its extensions pertaining to Operation & Routine/Breakdown maintenance of Earth moving machineries like dozers, Excavators, Back hoe loader/JCB, locomotives etc./Routine and or Breakdown Maintenance of Mechanical equipments in coal handling plant in any thermal power plant of capacity 210 MW or above of value not less than Rs.76.62 lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any one year during the preceding five years. The intended bidder shall upload the scanned copy of original satisfactory work done certificate from Govt. Organization/reputed private organization issued by competent authority in any of the preceding five years. (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

The intending bidder in his name should have a minimum annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.307 lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any of the two years of preceding five years and should upload the scanned copy of original latest audited balance sheets including profit and loss account for preceding five completed financial years duly signed by chartered accountant as documentary evidence.(Financial turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.)

The intending bidder shall not have been subject to forfeiture of EMD/foreclosure/ termination of their contract in KPCL/government or any other utility and have not been blacklisted for participation in tender issued by KPCL or government or any other utility in India during the past 3 years.
